product: Create Lakeflow Designer parameters while configuring fields (Public Preview)
tagline: Create a parameter from a supported operator field in Lakeflow Designer, then use it in the field.
what_it_does: Create a parameter from a supported operator field in Lakeflow Designer, then use it in the field. Parameters in Lakeflow Designer are named values defined for the visual data prep as a whole. You can reference parameters in SQL and Python operator code, in supported operator configuration fields, and in expressions that enable or disable operators.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
